summary.text: Peter Strand is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 63 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he recently retired after 28 years teaching in the Bozeman Public Schools.

paragraphs.text: Strand was born in San Francisco, California, and earned a bachelor's degree from Occidental College in 1987 and a graduate degree from Lesley University in 1993.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey answers he said he moved to Bozeman in 1995 and taught in the Bozeman Public Schools for 28 years before retiring.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with Bozeman Public Schools and the Montana Federation of Public Employees.
Strand took office in January 2025 and was assigned to the House State Administration, Local Government and Education committees for the 2025-2026 session.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
In his survey, Strand named affordability, public education funding, housing and the protection of public lands as his priorities.
